title: World Bloom — With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!
meta.Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's training continues as they each pursue their dreams. When they're called over to SEKAI by Rin and the others one day, they find an expansive new land awaiting them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-Wh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What is this place?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Surprised, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes! Our super secret plan to surprise you guys went off without a hitch!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, we're surprised...
But what is this place? A harbor...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It seems like it...
But I don't remember seeing this in SEKAI until now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
This is so so so cool!
Look at the sea! It's so sparkly! And that big boat!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin and Len were the ones who first discovered this place.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and then we decided that all of you had to see it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We apologize for saying it was an emergency. That must've startled you quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No! I mean, yes, it was startling, but I'm so happy you called us over☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it is strange how this place apparently just appeared overnight...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Strange indeed. Why did it appear? For what purpose?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Good question.
I can't say for sure...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I believe it has something to do with your feelings, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My feelings?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, because this SEKAI was born out of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, any changes that occur in your feelings can conceivably lead to changes occurring here too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That being said, it very rarely happens.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But what's changed?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did you start deeesperately wanting to see the sea?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, not particularly...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then! Did you really, really get the urge to go on a cruise?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, I don't think that's it either... Actually, we went to the beach for that film shoot, so maybe it was lingering somewhere within my subconscious...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In other words, there's no clear reason.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, let's try exploring this area!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We should look around for clues to see how your feelings have changed! Who knows what we'll find?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, yes! I wanna go exploring too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
Let's go see what secrets are hidden in this area☆

rows.Speaker: Rin, Emu & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, wait! Don't run off like that!
We still have no idea what this place is like!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, geez... Running after them puts you in the same category.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand their restlessness. I'm also curious to see what's actually here.

rows.Speaker: Len's Voice
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
We can board the ship from here!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun.
Let's go, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, let's explore to see what this new area has to offer.
Aboard the Ship

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This is truly a big ship...
And a well-built one at that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm noticing quite a few places where it's been repaired. My guess is that it's been in service for a very long time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which means it's probably been to a lot of different places.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone, look!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Look at what?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This thing Miku and I found while exploring the ship! Check it out!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, isn't this...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
A map.
With several islands charted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, there's something written in the corner...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It says...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “To the fabled Star Island”...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Star Island...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That's what it says...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's a star-shaped island on the very edge of the map. I believe it's referring to that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. That's so cute! It looks like some sort of snack!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
An island with “star” in its name...
This place intrigues me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Star Island...
And a map that can take you to it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is something the matter, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, well... This map may be strongly connected to the feelings that caused this new area to appear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Can you elaborate a little further?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This SEKAI was originally born out of your desire to become a star who can bring smiles to people all around the world.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Star Island... This map leading there...
They may be of great significance to this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah... I see what you mean.
Then, we should inspect this map a little more closely and—

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, the wind...!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Wind speed recorded at 13 m/s.
A somewhat strong sea breeze.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, the map!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, it flew away.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't just stare!
It's game over if we let it fall into the water.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We need to catch it somehow...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
There's a biiig bird flying up above!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, we don't have time for that right—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, what the...?!
“Big” is putting things far too lightly!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This bird. Isn't it a...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Red feathers that appear to be burning... A long, sharp beak and a wingspan of at least three meters...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I may be mistaken, but it appears to be a mythical creature known as a phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! A phoenix...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow☆ It's a real phoenix!
This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But they don't exist in real—
Oh, I guess that doesn't matter in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Get down...!
It's coming right for us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-That was scary...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is anyone hurt?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
We're okay!
Wait, where'd the map go?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, I forgot!
Where could it have gone...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no! Look, everyone! I think it got hooked on that phoenix's wing!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-What do we do?
We're gonna lose sight of the phoenix at this rate!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's chase after it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to catch it and retrieve that map...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree...
Especially since that map seems to hold the key to understanding why this place appeared.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go!
Operation: Get the Map Back From That Phoenix is a go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's go!
Ready, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_wonder_op1
Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, that phoenix appeared to be headed in this direction...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hey, check it out! I got a big balloon!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Oh, we should go down to the water together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting this harbor to be a part of such a bustling city.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Look at all the plushies!
It's like a big festival!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Excuse me. Did any of you happen to see a large bird flying overhead?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: No, sorry. I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
I see. Thank you.
Enjoy yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There are so many plushies here, but none of them seem to know anything about that phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I tried asking around too. They all said they didn't see it either...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
But we may want to keep asking.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. Plus, Tsukasa and the others still might learn something—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hey, all of you!
We have some good news!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You have good news?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! While talking to some of the plushies...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We found that none of them knew anything about that phoenix, but they told us instead to ask around at the inn.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Apparently, lots of different plushies from all over gather there to talk about the rumors they've heard and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, which means one of them may've seen or heard something about that phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's try heading over there.
Outside the Inn

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The inn's supposed to be around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
It sounds like there's a fun party going on!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, is it coming from that place?!
I'm seeing a lot of plushies gathered outside talking☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It is like a party!
Wait, is that the inn we're looking for?

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: Ah, are you all guests?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And you are?

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line:
I'm the innkeeper.
We have a party going on today.

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: So, why don't you all join in on the fun?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah☆ I wanna talk to the plushies♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't forget that we're here to investigate!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
Joining in on this celebration may actually make it easier for us to draw out information.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: People do tend to be more talkative when they're in a good mood.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Good point...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, we can split up and ask around, while also enjoying this party!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: I don't know anything about this phoenix of yours.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
A phoenix? Like the mythical creature?
Are you sure you saw one?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Sorry we can't help you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, thanks for talking to us!
You guys enjoy yourselves☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... No one here seems to know anything about that phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose information should be difficult to come by considering how incredibly rare a creature it seems to be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Hey, wanna hear me sing?
I'm from an island where everyone's a great singer!

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: I'm looking for work. I'll do anything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm seeing so many different types of plushies here. Mermaids, androids...

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: Well, of course! What you're seeing here is a gathering of plushies from all different islands.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, does that mean there's a Mermaid Island and an Android Island?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Mermaids and androids...
Hehe. It reminds me of our shows.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Do you think that's important?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: SEKAI was born out of Tsukasa's feelings, so they may be a reflection of his personal experiences.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. It's really never a dull moment here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Whoa, look! What's going on with those plushies?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh? O-Oh no!
They're hurt all over!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some have their eyes popped out, and others are wrapped in bandages... I feel really bad for them...

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line:
Haha. Don't feel bad!
They're from Zombie Island!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, okay☆
They're zombies! Now it all makes sense!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, there's no need to worry♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Are you gonna ask them about that phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but... Would that be a bad idea?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Just be careful!
The last time I tried talking to them, they decided to bite me for no reason!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Th-They bit you...?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
I didn't get hurt...
But they're a really grumpy bunch, so be really careful when you go over to talk to them.

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like they're a bit of an odd bunch.

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: They're not actually evil or anything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, is that so?

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah. In the beginning, they tried their best to make friends with everyone. You see, biting someone is apparently how folks greet each other on their island.

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: But people have a tendency to judge a book by its cover, and they were misunderstood...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Misunderstood...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really...?
That's so sad...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Imagine wanting to get to know someone better, but them feeling scared of how you look and the way you greet them. That'd definitely make me sad...

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line: Which is why they're somewhat prickly now. They've completely given up on trying to get along with everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Still, aren't they lonely...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In any case, we should try talking to them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They may know something about that phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hello there.
Do you all have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We have a question for you all.
We're looking for a phoenix that—

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh my.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
H-He bit you!
Are you hurt, Rui?!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm okay. It doesn't hurt.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Oh, perhaps he's replying to my initial greeting with his own?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, I should give a greeting in return.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Pardon me.
CHOMP.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna chomp too!
That looks like fun☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too☆
CHOMP.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
Wh-What are you all doing...?
Weirdos...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, there's something we wanna ask you zombies!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're looking for a phoenix☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But we don't know where it went...
Do you guys happen to know anything about it?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
A phoenix...?
Are you talking about...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: No, I'm not telling you anything!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, why not?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
Because you're trying to trick us!
You're not trying to become our friends! You think we're ugly and say nasty things about us behind our backs!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line:
What he said!
You hate us, so why should we help you?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, that's not true!
We don't hate you...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Hmph... You're lying.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Everyone else before you ran away scared when we tried to make friends with them...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's true that some of the other plushies are scared of you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But dispelling them of those fears should help you all get along better. Help them understand that you want to become friends with them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, he's right!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Y-You think that would work...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah☆ So, let's go over and talk to them♪ I'll help you guys break the ice!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: No, go away!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Because there's no way we can ever be friends...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (There's no way...?)

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line: Hmph... Let's go. We're leaving!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Those zombies seemed so sad...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah...
And if nothing changes, they're gonna keep getting misunderstood...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh...
Nothing's wrong. It's just...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They reminded me of my own past...
Wonderland SEKAI
Outside the Inn

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your past, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There was a time when I'd also given up on wanting to be around others...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right... Before you met everyone, you were putting on shows all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, because I'd fallen under the impression that no one would ever understand me or how I thought...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In reality, I wanted to do shows with others.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But no one was able to understand my shows, which led me to think that I shouldn't even bother with them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And then, I met...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Meeting all of you made me realize that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And since then, I've changed quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So much so that I looked for ways in which we could keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...! Are you talking about Emu?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. In retrospect, what I did seems rather selfish.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
You guys get to keep chasing your dreams together because you worked up the courage to go talk to Emu's brothers.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And here we are now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, you may be right.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I honestly couldn't be happier about how we're able to keep doing shows together like this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All this may also apply to our zombies. They act all prickly... But deep down, they seem to want to be friends with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, I'd like to help them turn that wish into a reality.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Just like how you all did for me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna help the zombies!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... But how do we do that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe... In our case, I suppose there's always only one answer. We need to do...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do what...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello, my zombie friends!

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
What?! You again?!
Look, we're not telling you anything about that phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I'm here to ask you about something else.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Would you like to do a show with us?
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Hm? Why are there so many plushies gathered here?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
They're doing a show!
And the plushies from Zombie Island are gonna be in it!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
What?! The zombies?
That sounds scary... But what's it supposed to be about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We have quite an audience here now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! Ready!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You really caught us by surprise when you said that we're doing a show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we all know exactly what to do since this is a modified rendition of Potato Ghosts!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Zombies, are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushie
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah.
But...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: Maybe this isn't such a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: We agreed to do this after you told us over and over that we'd be able to become friends with everyone if we did... But I still get the feeling that they're gonna be scared of us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't worry! I'm sure they'll all be smiling in the end!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, shows have that kind of power. Please trust me.

rows.Speaker: Zombie Plushies
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We also need to thank you for allowing us to put on a show here on such short notice, Mr. Innkeeper.

rows.Speaker: Gorilla Plushie
rows.Line:
Nah, that's all good.
I mean, shows and parties go hand in hand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Then, we'll get started.
A real zombie show with our plushie friends here.

rows.Speaker: Park Staff Member
rows.Line: “Director! We have a remarkably large audience today!”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“Oh? Excellent!
Let's see what sort of demographic it is this time... Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line: “Those look like...zombies!”
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“No...!
Stay away. You're never going to catch me!”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “Wait. We just want to... Ow!”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line:
“Oh, you went for quite the tumble.
Your head and arms appear to have fallen off... A-Are you okay...?”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “We're fine! I mean...”

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “We're zombies!”

rows.Speaker: Park Director
rows.Line: “I forgot! I need to keep running!”

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Haha. The zombies are funny!

rows.Speaker: Zombies
rows.Line: “CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Park Director

Then, one day, I saw that phoenix...
I thought it was so grand and was completely awestruck by its majesty...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Which is when I decided to learn everything I could about it.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: And someday... After I've gained more knowledge about it, I want to see it up close and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Oh, um... This is going to sound really silly...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: But I want to fly in the sky with it someday...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: With that phoenix?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Yes. I thought it'd be just so wonderful to fly freely through the sky with that phoenix...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What a super duper amazingly fantastic dream!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, how cool would it be to fly with that phoenix?! I got excited just listening to you talk about your dream!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: But there's no way it'll ever come true, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Why not?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Because that phoenix only appears once in a blue moon... Also, I can't fly since I'm not a bird plushie.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: And everyone else has already told me that my dream is never going to come true.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
And I know that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rion...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (There were a lot of times when I thought my dreams would never come true...)

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Emu. Keep your dreams to yourself. We're through dealing with you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Shosuke and the others told me to get my head out of the clouds...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't give up, Rion!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Emu...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your dream will never come true if you start believing that it won't...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, don't give up...!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
But...
My dream's so ridiculous...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, maybe it is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I also think that it's really important to keep believing in your dream...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You gotta keep believing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because one of them might just be the key to making it actually come true...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Yes, I see your point...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: But believing in something that I feel isn't ever going to come true is just so hard...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know...
I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: For the longest time, I had a lot of trouble getting my dreams to come true and endured a lot of pain.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I sometimes thought about giving up because it seemed so much easier... Just like you, Rion.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I had others tell me that I didn't have to give up.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: You didn't have to give up...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Not only that...
They even helped come up with ways to help make my dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then, it actually ended up coming true!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Emu, Tsukasa, Nene and Rui all worked very hard to make the Wonder Stage a place that's full of smiles.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not to mention how everyone working at the park helped them protect Phoenix Wonderland after hearing how they wanted to make it a place where everyone smiles forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And don't forget how they figured out a way to stay together while chasing after their dreams.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: They did all of that...?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: But I'm just...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't worry! I'll help you make it happen☆

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Making your dream come true all by yourself is really hard, but it's a lot easier when you have others helping you, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: By putting our heads together, we should be able to come up with a way to make it come true!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, Rion, let's brainstorm and come up with a good idea!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Naturally, I'll be helping as well!
I feel compelled to after hearing your story!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
I really don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:

As long as I don't give up, my dream might someday come true...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rion...!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: So, your help will be much appreciated.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Please help me figure out a way to make my dream of flying with that phoenix a reality!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's start coming up with ways to fly with that phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, how do we make this happen?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, what if we used the flying train?
That could help us fly alongside that phoenix☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... Unfortunately, that train sort of has a mind of its own. Getting it to fly alongside that phoenix may be a bit difficult.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, what if we got on the phoenix's back?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! On its back?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! A lot of fantasy movies and stuff involve flying on the backs of big birds, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, on the back of a big bird...?
That sounds very comfy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean... Is that actually possible?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Based on the size of that phoenix, a plushie like Rion should have no problem riding on its back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's try asking it!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Asking it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll just ask, “Please let him ride on your back as you fly!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Slow down. A bird isn't going to understand what we're saying...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, wait. We've already made friends with all these plushies.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But, how are we going to talk to it if we don't know where it is?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Oh, right... That does complicate things, but I have an idea regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: I've actually been collecting any records I can find of that phoenix appearing in the harbor for quite some time, and I recently made a discovery.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Whenever it does decide to visit, it always goes to its favorite spot.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, if we go there, we'll be able to find it?!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Well, it's just one possibility...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nevertheless, our odds of finding it are certainly much better than if we just continued to stand around here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
Let's go find that phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Line: And you're going out of your way to help me... That just makes me feel even worse...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, that's a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Keep that feeling in mind because it will help you succeed.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What I'm trying to say is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The frustration and despair you're feeling will drive you to succeed. They'll help you move forward!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: They will?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes! Trust me, Rion.
I guarantee that those feelings will help you succeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't run from them. Accept your current situation and keep pushing forward...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you do so, your dream will come true!!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (You're right, Tsukasa.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Because that's exactly what you've been doing.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (All in order to become a star who can make the whole world smile...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It's a colossal dream, but that hasn't stopped you... You've faced a myriad of challenges and obstacles along the way, so I'm sure you'll...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, Rion...
No matter what happens, we'll be there for you both. So, please do your best.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Plus, if this doesn't work out, we can always come up with a different way to make your dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much, KAITO, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But for now, this is our last attempt...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Phoenix...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(We will catch you...
It doesn't matter how high you fly. We will succeed!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, Rion! Cast the net!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, it dodged the net...!)

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We couldn't reach it...! No, we still have a chance...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't give up, Rion! Keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter how hard it may seem, keep trying to make your dream come true!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Huh...?! What are they...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Roar*

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: *Scream*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We can make iiiiiit!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They're flying...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, look...! Tsukasa's hand touched the phoenix!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Everyone! Get the landing pad ready!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Noooooooooo! We're falling!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Waaaaahhhhh!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa! Rion! Are you two okay...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes... Thank goodness for the landing pad...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
I-I'm also fine...
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Low battery reserves.
Entering power-saving mode.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for all your hard work, Robo-Nene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, the phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We failed again...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, everyone...
Even after all the help you've given me...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, don't apologize!
Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, look! There's something stuck to your back!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What's this...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's a phoenix feather.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A phoenix feather...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It looks like you reached it, if only briefly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it seems that way!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: To think that you could lay a hand on me...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Ph-Phoenix...?!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: I am still struggling to understand how creatures without wings such as yourselves could reach me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
Yes, you merely touched me.
You did not catch me as we agreed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: But you do not plan on giving up, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: The day you do finally manage to catch me, I shall grant your wish.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Yes. That day may never actually come, but I can use this as a way to pass the time.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Also, I believe you were looking for this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, the map we found on that ship!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! I'd completely forgotten about that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, you seriously forgot?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's very like you, Tsukasa.
I was actually under the impression that you were refraining from bringing that up so as not to steal the spotlight from Rion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I-In any case, we need that...!
So, Phoenix, please return it to us!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Yes, fine.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Really...?

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: Did I not say that I would do as you say if you managed to catch me?

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line: So, think of this as a small reward for even touching me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! Thanks, Phoenix!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Phoenix
rows.Line:
Your name is Rion, yes?
Please come back to try and catch me whenever you like.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I will...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, there it goes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it sorta gave us a smile before it left...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if this is that phoenix's way of expressing its happiness over having finally found a worthy adversary?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe☆ That means you gotta catch it someday!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Yes, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: Thank you for what you did, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: I'm going to accept my shortcomings and keep moving forward. I'm going to make my dream come true someday...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: I agree with what you said, Tsukasa. And I was able to take a big step today as a result.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rion...

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line:
I promise to keep doing my best.
I'm going to keep chasing after that phoenix, and catch it someday.

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: And I will get it to let me fly on its back!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, keep trying!

rows.Speaker: Rion
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No matter how hard things get, no matter how much you fail, you have to keep trying.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That's how I'm going to make my dream come true.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Nice work, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was impressed by how you were able to inspire Rion to keep chasing after his dream.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? You were? I was just doing what I always do! Hah hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I also felt inspired.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seeing Rion want to keep chasing after his dream made me want to do the same.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I also feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? You do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, because you'll all likely be faced with all sorts of challenges as you keep moving ahead.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, as you helped Rion just now...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I plan on giving you all the support I can. Watching you today reaffirmed that for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you, KAITO! I promise to not let those words go to waste. Because I am...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Destined to become a star who makes the whole world smile!

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_wonder_ed4
Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We finally got that map back...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but it took us the entire day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Still, we got to do a show with those zombies, ride on a turtle and chase that phoenix around with Rion. It was a fun day in my book☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. I agree!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we have the map again, we might be able to figure out what feelings went into this place...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right.
Then, let's take another look at it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Upon closer inspection, this map seems to cover a vast area.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm seeing the names of several different islands...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, this island has some kind of symbol next to it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What does it mean?
Some islands have symbols, but others don't...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The ones that do also have names!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, you're right! Here's Zombie Island, Mermaid Island and... Oh, this one's Android Island!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, we met plushies from all these islands at that inn!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A thought crossed my mind while we were there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These islands seem to be linked to the shows we've done in the past.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You may be right.
But linked in what way...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if this ship has already been to these places?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's like the journey you and the others have been on, Tsukasa. This ship seems to have traveled to all these other islands on its way to Star Island.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This ship is like us...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think so. More precisely, it's a physical manifestation of your present feelings, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This ship traveled to all these islands in the hopes of reaching Star Island at the end.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(In that sense, we are one and the same.
I have traveled far and done many things on my journey to stardom.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And those feelings have manifested themselves in the form of this ship...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, wait...
I wasn't able to get here by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I met Emu and the others, and we began doing shows together. I came this far because of them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's it?! Did you figure something out, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I think this place...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It represents my desire to become a star while growing alongside my friends as we travel to different places.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That may be what's behind all this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm inclined to agree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, these symbols must represent our accomplishments...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means the ones that aren't are places we might be going to in the future.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, now I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, is there a way for us to get this ship to sail?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We should all go together! To Star Island!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What?! Is such a thing even possible...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm not sure...
But if that's where this ship wants to go, I think we should help it get there!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree! And we can go if we get it to sail!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wanna go too!
I need to see what Star Island looks like!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but sailing a ship is easier said than done... Would we even be able to do that...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Ship operation program available for installation.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, Robo-Nene, I doubt you alone can get it to run. I'm pretty sure we're all gonna have to work together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, what if we asked some of the plushies for help?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Great idea!
It sounded like a lot of them in the harbor may know a thing or two about operating this vessel!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Come to think of it, a lot of them said that they came here on boats and ships!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Yes, asking them for help does seem like a good idea. Not only that, we appear to have everything we need for our journey, so we should be able to cast off whenever.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
Naturally, I'll also be going!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter the cost, I must see what Star Island looks like for myself!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What about you, Nene?! You're coming too, right?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
There's no way to stop you guys at this point, huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Fine, I'll go. I do also wanna see what Star Island looks like.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent! Then...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's set sail to Star Island!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-Whyyy?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We keep getting pushed back every time we try to cast off...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The tide appears to be the problem.
It may be why we keep getting sent back to port.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, does that mean we can't go to Star Island...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, I'm sure we still can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't actually know, but I still think we can! Tsukasa, I believe that you and the others will make it to Star Island someday!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have faith in you all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree with Miku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe that you'll get there someday, but that it's still too early for you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still too early...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You don't see yourself as a star yet, do you, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I... Of course not.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, as you and the others meet new people and continue to grow one step at a time...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your path to becoming a star may finally open up, and SEKAI may reflect that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. As I grow alongside the others...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll grow as we sail the seas together on this long voyage... All while aboard the Pegasus Special Deluxe Wonder!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He already came up with a name for it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's good that he's so full of optimism.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu! Nene! Rui!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Our dreams may all be different.
But we are all headed towards making them a reality.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let us keep pushing each other to become better as we strive to make them come true!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. The four of you never change. You're always doing your best and working towards your dreams.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And we're gonna keep giving you guys all the support we can☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that would be greatly appreciated!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, let's do our usual thing to mark the occasion!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Ready, everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to keep pushing toward our dream!!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Let's do this, wonderhoy!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see how you guys' journey unfolds.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me neither☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone! Look!
There's something growing by the ship!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? That looks like... A plant? A sprout?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, it's so adorably tiny☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't know what kind of plant this is, but I have a feeling that it's going to grow big and strong...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course it's going to!
After all, it's made from Tsukasa's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, it's probably gonna end up being huge!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's keep a close eye on this little sprout while we watch Tsukasa and the others grow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah!
